# SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — NOT the real CWN SRD.
#
# This file mimics the *text layout* of the Cities Without Number SRD §3.0.0
# equipment chapter so the CWN extraction tool (story 114-5) can be exercised in
# unit tests without depending on the real, out-of-repo SRD PDF. The rows below
# are invented, schema-shaped stand-ins. Values are deliberately NOT the real SRD
# numbers — this is a parser fixture, not bound content.
#
# Per ADR-145 D4 the four Without Number SRDs share ONE item schema, so the
# Armor / Melee / Ranged / General sections use the same column layout as the WWN
# fixture. CWN's net-new section is **Cyberware**, whose defining mechanical extra
# is **System Strain** (ADR-145 D4: "system_strain for cyberware"). The real CWN
# §3.6.7 cyberware column layout is:
#
#   Name   Cost   Location   Concealment   System Strain   Effect
#
# System Strain is a non-negative **number** raising the permanent-strain floor on
# install. It is often FRACTIONAL — CWN prices common chrome at 0.25/0.5 — so the
# first row below carries strain 0.25 to exercise the float path (an int would
# truncate it to a "free" implant). The first arabic number in a row is the Cost,
# the second is the System Strain; Roman-numeral name grades are safe.

§3.0.0 Equipment

§3.0.1 Armor
Name                AC    Cost    Enc
Test Armor Weave    14    300     1
Test Combat Frame   17    4000    2

Name                Damage   Shock      Enc   Cost   Attribute
Test Mono Katana    1d8      2/AC15     1     500    Dex
Test Shock Baton    1d6      1/AC13     1     100    Str
